title: Hamburger SV - Wikipedia
content: Though the current HSV was founded in June 1919 from a merger of three earlier clubs, it traces its origins to 29 September 1887 when the first of the predecessors, SC Germania, was founded. The team's most successful period was from the mid-1970s until the mid-1980s when, in addition to several domestic honours, they won the 1976–77 European Cup Winners' Cup and the 1982–83 European Cup. The outstanding players of this period were Horst Hrubesch, Manfred Kaltz, and Felix Magath, all regulars in the West German national team. Up until the 2017–18 Bundesliga season, which found the team relegated for the first time in history, HSV's football team had the distinction of being the only team that had played continuously in the top tier of the German football league system since the founding of the club at the end of World War I.

title: Information & Benefits | HSV.de
content: Join the club that you fell in love with to make your voice heard and become a part of something special. As a member of Hamburger Sport-Verein e.V., you have the ability to vote on matters which are put to the members, as well as at the club’s A.G.M. and various elections on who takes what position in the club’s hierarchy. On top of that, you have access to reduced season ticket prices, special items of merchandise and are able to buy tickets for home and away matches before they go on general sale. For €5 a month, you can become a HSV member (*Förderndes Mitglied*) as well as a member of the HSV Supporters’ Club (more information **here**). Through a one-off payment of €1,887 (the founding year of the club), you can become a lifetime member of HSV e.V., something that is also available for current members of the club.
